taste.name: State lives in the glyph, not the row
taste.trigger: When showing status, priority and labels on hundreds of items in a list
taste.decision: Chose 14px glyphs with semantic color and a distinct shape (dashed, empty, half-filled, check, cross) next to neutral text, over colored badges, tinted row backgrounds or colored text
taste.reason: Because in a long list a glyph in a fixed column is caught by peripheral vision; painted rows turn the list into a patchwork and color stops meaning anything
evidence: /mobile status sheet: 8 states differ by shape as well as hue

taste.name: Four greys do the work of four sizes
taste.trigger: When ordering title, metadata, date and secondary text inside 32-40px rows
taste.decision: Chose four text luminance steps (#F7F8F8, #D0D6E0, #8A8F98, #62666D) at 12-15px over a wider type scale or heavier weights
taste.reason: Because changing size changes row height and breaks the list rhythm; dimming keeps the row compact and still says what to read first

taste.name: No shadow on what does not float
taste.trigger: When separating sidebar, panel, cards and chips on a near-black page
taste.decision: Chose a luminance ladder (#08090A > #0F1011 > #1C1C1F > #232326) plus 1px rings at 0.05-0.08 white over the soft drop shadow on every card that comparable SaaS sites use
taste.reason: Because on a dark ground a drop shadow is barely visible and muddies edges; lighter reads as nearer instantly, so the shadow is kept for what truly sits on top

taste.name: On the phone, choices go to the thumb in a sheet
taste.trigger: When moving status changes and snoozing to mobile
taste.decision: Chose a bottom sheet with a grabber, full-width rows (icon + label left, value right in tertiary grey) and a check on the current item over dropdowns, popovers or inline chips
taste.reason: Because the reachable zone on a phone is the bottom of the screen and a full-width row is a large target that needs no precision; the right-aligned value lets you decide without opening anything else
evidence: /mobile Status sheet: 8 rows, check on the current state
/mobile Snooze sheet: 4 rows with time/date right-aligned in #8A8F98
